stem: What is most likely a SIMILAR reason the author and the poet included this quotation and this line?
instruction:
Read this quotation from the story and this line from the poem.

"It’s something to see," he said solemnly. (paragraph 4 of “Moon Landing”)

Just imagine, they say. (line 4 of “The Apollo 11 Moon Landing”)

options.label: A
options.text: To suggest that people find the moon landing entertaining to watch

options.label: B
options.text: To emphasize the idea that the moon landing has historical importance

options.label: C
options.text: To imply that people disagree about the value of the moon landing

options.label: D
options.text: To stress the idea that the moon landing contributes to scientific knowledge

visual_elements: "It’s something to see," he said solemnly. (paragraph 4 of “Moon Landing”)
